decisions.reason: As a recently launched, website-visible extension of the firm's automation and monitoring offer, it likely embodies meaningful development effort and strategic fit with digital efficiency goals, so management would tend to continue it and attribute any early weakness to normal market ramp-up.

Although the web tool is probably lighter-weight and easier to discontinue than a full engineered system, it still supports the firm's planner-facing solutions portfolio and public digitalization narrative, so management is more likely to retain it than to admit a premature misstep.

A fouling detection system fits closely with the firm's established integrated infrastructure, monitoring, and optimization business and likely required specialized engineering investment, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
